title: Review discovery, bugs and the next build each week

steps.do: Give every new bug a priority from P0 to P3 with its steps to reproduce, and list open P0 and P1 bugs.
Count this week's customer interviews, usability sessions and calls, and flag the week if there were none.
For each handoff proposed as a build, check that all four risks have evidence; one that lacks it goes back as a discovery task.

Read retention and the product-market fit survey against the telos, and when the evidence contradicts the current direction, prepare a continue, stop or change decision for the founder with the evidence.
Propose the order of next week's product work to the product lead, with the bug or evidence behind each item.

done_criteria.check: Does every build handoff proposed this week cite evidence for value, usability, feasibility and viability?
